title: Countries visited and the band on the Middle East tour
summary: The tour covered Turkey, Jordan, Kuwait, Syria, Pakistan, Egypt and Iran with a band including Sweets Edison and Earl Palmer.

bands.name: Benny Carter's Middle East tour band

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe

blocks.x: ... in these countries. What were they? Do you remember all of the countries -- all the places we went to?
Oh, well ... I know there were 7 countries. Let' see, there was Turkey, there was Jordan, there was Kuwait, Syria, there was Pakistan, there was Egypt, and what's the one I don't recall?
Iran. Of course, oh yes, Iran. That's right.
I think that was the second place.
To ask you if you have an overall impression of that, I'm afraid may not be a very meaningful question. But let's leave it as asked. Before we do that, tell us who you took along with you.
Well, we took Gildo Mahoney, on the piano, John B. Williams on the bass, Earl Palmer on the drums, and Harry Sweets Edison as our star trumpet player.
